description: Installation production électrique solaire par commune en 2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays de Saint-Omer. This dataset concerns the solar power generation installation per municipality in 2020. The variable data taken into account by the dataset are the solar account per municipality, the power of connection, as well as their geographical coordinates. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays de Saint-Omer. The portal shows the English title as "Installation of solar power generation by municipality in 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays de Saint-Omer. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2022-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
